title: 38th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/38/2024).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominees for members of the Tax Appeal Tribunal (Tax Administration Act, Law No. 3/2010, Article 56(a)(1)) are sent to the relevant standing committee for review.
Preliminary debate on the Bill amending the Export Import Act of the Maldives (Law No. 31/79), submitted on behalf of the government by Machchangolhi North MP Ibrahim Mohamed.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent Tax Appeal Tribunal nominees to committee and began debate on the Export Import Act amendment bill.
